skill.description: Canonical verb. null for non-capability lines (assistance, administrative).

variant_number.description: Permanent within its stem. Never reused, never reassigned.

taxonomy.description: Node in vocabulary/taxonomy.yaml: the capability this line scores. Many entries may share a node.

modifiers.description: Object/environment properties only. NOT grasp technique or hardware method.

objects.description: Profiles from vocabulary/objects.yaml handled by this line. Supply the object-side difficulty factors.

conditions.description: Situation-side difficulty factors (source: condition in vocabulary/difficulty_factors.yaml) mapped to a level, or to a list of levels when the level is drawn at test time.

failure_mode.description: Penalties only: key of failure_modes in vocabulary/taxonomy.yaml, so equal failures can be priced consistently.

points.description: Priced exactly once, here. null only when the rulebook leaves it unpriced or a formula applies.

points_formula.description: Used instead of points when the value derives from the challenge total (e.g. §3.8.3).
